title: Linked plan findings read from latest run phase1/out even when the run is not complete (REQ-0099)
requirement: REQ-0099: linked_repos.py reads a linked plan like an in-plan group: runs/latest/phase1/out whenever it has findings files, not only when run.json says complete
acceptance_criteria: linked_repos._link uses runs/latest/phase1/out when it holds *.json, whatever run.json status; results/ stays the fallback
a running s2s run (parked at cp2b) gives its repos findings in graph/linked.json; no claude call
single-source linked plans and complete runs unchanged; tests pass

design.summary: linked_repos._link reads runs/latest/phase1/out whenever it holds json, not only for a complete run; results/ stays fallback
risks: half-written phase1 of a running run: missing repos keep the WARNING

implementation.summary: _link uses runs/latest/phase1/out when it holds json, any run status; results/ fallback

unit_test.result: linked_repos_test pass=26 fail=0 (U1 fails 3x on old code); run_all 188 suites, failures only ext_scan, track_hook, tracking_new_only (known) and pipeline_pool_test.sh (load flake: passes alone 58/0, no link to linked_repos); real scratch s2s check 8/8 repos done

security.result: no REPOS_ROOT read, no model call, stdlib only; reads findings files of a linked plan by name

verification.command: bash tests/linked_repos_test.sh; scratch s2s build (work/TASK-132/evidence/real_s2s.txt); git diff frozen prompts
verification.result: 26/0; 8 of 8 s2s repos done with run.json running; frozen prompts diff 0 bytes

designer.waiver: two-line change, design written by the coordinator
